productName: Long Distance Touch Vibration Bracelet for Couples
title: Worth it! Best purchase for long distance relationship
content: Hands down the best gift ever! Main Mumbai me hoon aur boyfriend Bangalore me. Jaise hi bracelet touch karti hoon, unka bracelet light up aur vibrate karta hai! Delivery 3 din me aa gayi with beautiful packing.

title: Wonderful and beautifful
content: Crystal quality is top notch! LED light base on karne ke baad 3D photo bilkul live lagti hai. Mom and Dad ko anniversary par gift diya tha, unko bohot pasand aaya.

title: The edit is fantastic
content: Hamari family photo ka laser wood engraving itna clear aayega maine socha nahi tha. Wooden texture bohot solid hai. 100% recommended!

title: Absolutely beautiful original note.
content: Mere bhai ke date of birth se match karta hua serial number wala original note mila! Frame packing royal lagti hai. Unique gift idea in India.
